notes.title: Last Weekend to Play Current Demo
notes.content:
The current Line Clipper: Tennis Tactics demo will be removed from Steam Monday, May 5th, so if you would like to try out the demo, please do so this weekend. Taking the demo down will allow for smoother development of parts of the game not included in the demo while keeping the demo from becoming unrepresentative of the current state of the game. A new version of the demo will release around the launch of the game.

Thanks to everyone who has given feedback on the demo!

notes.title: Demo v1.01 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed bug allowing serves to be returned before the ball bounced.
[/list]

[h3]Balance Adjustments[/h3]
[list]
[*] Narrowed strike zone for half-volleys.
[*] Adjusted backspin groundstrokes to be slightly better at handling shots with high incoming velocity.
[*] Adjusted backspin groundstrokes to be slightly better at handling shots above the strike zone.
[*] Adjusted how CPUs decide whether or not to let the ball bounce.
[/list]
